snippet.title: [PuzzleGame] Ninja Ming: Wu - #1 (end)
snippet.description:
Ninja Ming: Wu
A Platformer Puzzle Game by 1 Poss Studio

Steam Store:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569750/Ninja_Ming_Wu/

--------------------------------
(via About This Game on Steam)

A mini 2D puzzle platformer procuded by Ninja Ming's team.
Players may Flash to resolve puzzles.

How to win?
Meet the goal, and touch the flag to win.

Features
- Flash-Skill
Shoot a bullet, then flash there.
- Ex-Flash
Shoot second bullet, then flash there.

Content
- About 1.5 hours of playtime
- 50+ levels

#playthrough #puzzle #puzzlegame #puzzleplatformer
